text:
maria: heads up — spotted a few staging snapshot uploads missing SSE-KMS header. tagging sec-eng for triage.

sam: paste an example object key?

maria: s3://redwood-backups/staging/snap-2026-03-30.tar.gz -> no x-amz-server-side-encryption or kms-key-id in metadata.

raj: cloudtrail shows PutObject by serviceAccount:backup-uploader at 2026-03-30T01:12:09Z, userAgent backup-agent/2.1.

emma: did the RBAC sweep run around midnight?

deploy-bot: rollout infra/rbac-sweep-2026-03-30 deployed at 2026-03-30T00:45:01Z. PR link: https://git.internal/infra/rbac-sweep-2026-03-30

sam: ran `aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd` — no grant for arn:aws:iam::123:role/backup-uploader after 00:50Z. looks like sweep removed it.

maria: mitigation plan: (1) emergency temp grant for backup-uploader on CMK, (2) apply bucket policy to deny PutObject without SSE-KMS, (3) patch uploader to assert header and fail-safe.

raj: opened revert PR to restore CMK grant and will do RCA on why wildcard was removed.

emma: add detection rule: alert on PutObject events to redwood-backups where x-amz-server-side-encryption is null. include runbook step to mark exposed snapshots.

oncall: monitoring rule applied to staging, will extend to prod canary. incident INC-2026-0430 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0430

maria: owners set: raj=RCA/revert, sam=emergency grant + uploader test, emma=runbook update + alerts. closing slack triage, follow in incident. :thumbsup:
